units.source_text: “不过，家庭似乎不是悲剧的舞台，而是悲剧的后台。

en.t: "However, the family seems not to be the stage of tragedy, but rather the backstage of tragedy.

units.source_text: 之所以说是后台……”信口雌黄的夫人顿时接不上话，

en.t: The reason I call it backstage is..." The lady, who had been talking recklessly, suddenly could not continue,
"Please do not turn me into all sorts of metaphors."
